aboutpara: Creative Director with more than a decade of end-to-end design experience — from pixel-perfect brand identities and print campaigns to broadcast-ready motion graphics and programmatic video templates. Known for building scalable design systems that eliminate creative bottlenecks, and for translating complex client briefs into high-impact visual stories across print, digital, and broadcast. Track record of leading international campaigns that have generated millions in donor acquisition and brand equity, while mentoring studio teams to consistently deliver at the highest standard.
